from collections import Counter
s,p=sys.stdin.read().split();m=len(p);need=Counter(p.replace('?',''));have=Counter();ans=0

 have[c]+=1
 if i>=m: have[s[i-m]]-=1
 if i>=m-1 and all(have[c]>=n for c,n in need.items()): ans+=1
print(ans)
